messages:
sara: Heads-up: new pen-test report just uploaded. Finding 4.1 — Private deployments with HSM-backed KMS: audit logs for API activity appear missing for some clusters. Pentester rated as High (regulatory proofing concern).

maya: on it. can you paste exact PoC/repro steps they used so we can see whether this is an ingestion gap vs control-plane query bug?

sara: PoC excerpt from report:
> 1) Provision Private cluster with customer HSM KMS (customer-kms)
> 2) Emit ~200 small generate requests over 3 hours to /api/v1/generate using test api keys
> 3) Call control-plane audit endpoint for that customer -> no entries returned for those keys
> 4) Inspect per-customer S3 bucket -> objects present but missing retention metadata and lifecycle tags

sara: PoC curl they included:
```
for i in {1..200}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://private.example.redwood/api/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_KEY" -d '{"input":"ping"}'
  sleep 5
done
```

alex: couple quick diagnostic questions:
- Are these clusters configured to forward audit events to per-customer S3 or an org-wide stream? we support both.
- Any chance these clusters are still running agent v0.9.1 (known retention-tag race condition)?

sara: pentester didn't include agent version. they said control-plane returned 200 for the generate calls but audit query empty.

devsec-bot: [scan] locating clusters with KMS=HSM and agent_version<=0.9.1. Matches: private-chi-05, private-eu-8, enterprise-pier-2. Recommend prioritizing these.

josh: I'll investigate private-chi-05. pulling agent logs and S3 HEADs now.

josh: S3 HEAD for sample object shows:
```
ETag: "f1d2d3"
x-amz-meta-retention-policy:
x-amz-meta-audit-version:
content-length: 512
```

josh: objects exist but retention metadata empty — looks like write-phase failed to attach metadata. likely the agent's metadata flush path raced with buffer rotation under burst.

kevin: important: are entries missing only for control-plane query, or are raw objects also missing? if raw objects are present we can backfill tags and provide evidence quickly.

josh: raw objects present. starting dry-run backfill to quantify.

josh: dry-run results for private-chi-05:
- scanned: 8,920 objects
- missing metadata: 2,123
- estimated tagging throughput: 280 ops/s

alex: proposed remediation plan:
1) Hotfix agent to perform atomic metadata commit before buffer rotation (PR #4321 ready)
2) Run backfill to add retention/audit metadata for affected buckets
3) Generate an evidence package: pre/post HEADs, backfill job logs, checksums, timestamps
4) Ask pentester to retest once backfills complete; or mark as mitigated with evidence if they accept

maria: from compliance view, missing retention tags prevent us from demonstrating immutable retention windows. we should treat this as High until backfills run for all impacted clusters.

maya: timeline? how long to push hotfix and complete backfills for the three clusters the bot found?

alex: hotfix -> build + staging deploy in ~3h, prod rollout after smoke in ~6h. backfills: parallel across clusters; estimate 2-4 hours total.

josh: initiating actual backfill for private-chi-05 now. progress updates attached.

devsec-bot: [job] backfill started for private-chi-05. dry-run matched. tagging in progress.

josh: backfill progress: 55% complete. currently ~1,167 objects tagged. logging to secure channel.

kevin: once backfill finishes, can infra produce a signed evidence bundle (list of keys + before/after HEADs + job log + sha256)? pentester/legal will expect signed artifacts.

alex: use infra tool s3-evidence: /infra/tools/s3-evidence --bundle --sign --include-prepost-heads

devsec-bot: [job] backfill finished for private-chi-05. 2,123 objects updated. bundle checksum sha256: b7c1e8d4...

josh: sample HEADs attached in logs:
BEFORE:
```
x-amz-meta-retention-policy:
x-amz-meta-audit-version:
```
AFTER:
```
x-amz-meta-retention-policy: RW-90d
x-amz-meta-audit-version: 1.3.0
```

maria: good. include a scope statement in bundle: clusters affected, time window, and exact keys updated. compliance needs to know whether customers need re-audit.

sara: drafting pentest response: include evidence bundle link, list of clusters found by scan, backfill statuses, hotfix PR/rollout plan, and retest schedule for remaining clusters.

maya: classification? Legal prefers we say: "Mitigated — partial (remediated for private-chi-05; remaining clusters scheduled)."

maria: agree with "Mitigated - partial" until all affected clusters confirmed.

alex: created follow-up tickets: AGENT-HOTFIX-4321, BACKFILL-private-eu-8, BACKFILL-enterprise-pier-2, and EVIDENCE-REVIEW.

sara: pentester replied: they'll wait 72 hours for remediation and retest the control-plane queries. they may lower severity if evidence + backfills complete.

josh: uploaded final evidence bundle to secure-evidence/private/1754001123-evidence.tar.gz and generated presigned link for pentester (expires in 7 days).

kevin: adding regression test: write a unit+integration test asserting metadata commit before buffer rotation under burst load.

sara: adding this thread to postmortem and pen-test response doc. Product-ops, please prepare customer comms template for regulated customers.

maria: @product-ops tagged. thanks team. will review wording with legal.

sara: closing loop when remaining clusters are backfilled and pentester confirms. thanks everyone.
